subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate order of the segments in the options that will fill in the blanks and make a coherent paragraph.

Though Sheela loves watching horror movies, __________ / __________ / __________ / __________ / she rented another romantic today.

options.text: she planned to try something different yesterday / so she rented the latest romantic / and to her surprise she enjoyed it very much / so much so that
and to her surprise she enjoyed it very much / so much so that / so she rented the latest romantic / she planned to try something different yesterday
so she rented the latest romantic / and to her surprise she enjoyed it very much / so much so that / she planned to try something different yesterday
so much so that / and to her surprise she enjoyed it very much / she planned to try something different yesterday / so she rented the latest romantic

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph starts by mentioning Sheela's love for horror movies and how she decided to try something different.
 
• **Sentence 1 is the first sentence** as it introduces Sheela's intention to try something different:
 
 
• "she planned to try something different yesterday"
 
 
 
• Sentence 2 is the second sentence as it ties in with her action of renting another romantic movie as a result of her experience:
 
 
• "so she rented the latest romantic"
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3 follows** as it shows the result of her attempt to try something different, highlighting her surprise and enjoyment:
 
 
• "and to her surprise she enjoyed it very much"
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4 is the last sentence **because it elaborates on the enjoyment of the new genre, emphasizing how much she liked it:
 
 
• "so much so that"
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **1**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Though Sheela loves watching horror movies, she planned to try something different yesterday, so she rented the latest romantic, and to her surprise, she enjoyed it very much, so much so that she rented another romantic today."
